answer_1.quote: Evaluating the system generated responses for open-domain dialogue is a difficult task.

answer_2.quote: We compare SSREM with the following response evaluation methods: • BLEU • ROUGE • EMB • RUBER • RSREM

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to annotate the scores of the responses.
answer_4.guideline: We ask two questions to the MTurkers. (1) How appropriate is the response overall? (2) How on-topic is the response?
